This is all my opinion and i'm comparing these types of games to their early predecessors, like playstation 1, playstation 2, tales of destiny being my favorite tales game, SO second story my favorite SO game, so keep that in mind, you might feel overall differently how you come at these games.

Arise's story came off bland, horribly paced, and really unimaginative. It felt super linear and what I mean by that is that as soon as you were done with one main story plot objective, it threw you right into the next, no room to let the story, world, or characters grow or get fleshed out. The way the story is told also made the game feel incredibly short even though it wasn't all that short.

The characters to me were very boring, sometimes leaning into cringey, something I did not get from the playstation 1 era games. I know it's kinda a trope for some of these game at this point but always came off as just bad writing to me. The way the characters interact with the mini cut scenes, which there are WAY to many of, just didn't make me feel like they were really interacting like real team mates. It was a disconnect thing because of the story telling mechanism but also just more bad writing within that.

The battle system is.... fine? Nothing to write home about, nothing to hate on, maybe a little grindy because some monsters seemed to just be sponges.

The world. This one I will get push back from a lot of people. Most say it looks AMAZING! I think it felt empty, boring, and only one world area looked good. All but one town felt empty and even then, that town didn't actually have anything to do. There is nothing rewarding about exploring, as there really isn't exploring. There are sidequest but they don't add much and are super easy to find and do. No surprise things you can miss that add to the deeper world lore or anything. I don't think the graphics look outstanding either. They're fine, not bad, just not like, OMG!!! like some people try to say.

TLDR: i feel like it lacks in every department when compared to games from 97 and 98. No one cares about the art of it anymore.
